title: Signature: Adversarial benchmark set
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): alongside the standard gold set, an adversarial set contains tasks designed to trigger known failure modes: ambiguous queries, contradictory sources, and edge-case inputs. Tools are scored on both; a tool that aces the standard set but collapses on the adversarial set is not production-ready. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers tasks targeting known failure modes.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 10, 2: 20, 3: 40}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
import random
random.seed(9)
std = sum(random.random() < 0.9 for _ in range(N)) / N
adv = sum(random.random() < 0.55 for _ in range(N)) / N
print("standard: %.2f | adversarial: %.2f | gap: %.2f" % (std, adv, std - adv))
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Benchmark drift alarm
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): benchmarks re-run on a schedule, and a statistically significant regression fires an alarm with the diff. Silent performance rot is how good tools go bad; the drift alarm makes rot loud. Alarms link to the exact runs before and after. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers scheduled re-runs of the benchmark suite.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: (0.90, 0.88), 2: (0.90, 0.82), 3: (0.90, 0.75)}
before, after = CFG[LEVEL]
drop = before - after
alarm = drop > 0.05
print("before %.2f -> after %.2f (drop %.2f) | alarm:" % (before, after, drop), alarm)

title: Signature: Human-calibrated scoring
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): rubric scores are anchored to human judgments: a sample of outputs is scored by people, and the automated rubric is calibrated until it agrees. Calibration is re-checked periodically because both tools and human standards drift. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers anchoring rubrics to human judgments.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 20, 2: 50, 3: 100}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
import random
random.seed(13)
agree = sum(1 for _ in range(N) if random.random() < 0.86)
print("human-rubric agreement: %d/%d = %.2f | calibrated:" % (agree, N, agree / N), agree / N >= 0.8)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.
